name: CHEEZY BITES|Al KARAMA
address: Era Building - 2 4A St - Al Karama - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Cheezy Bites is a Pakistani restaurant in Al Karama, Dubai, serving authentic Pakistani food alongside a selection of pizzas, burgers and Chinese favourites. Our Pakistani menu includes biryani, karahi, handi, nihari, paya, haleem, BBQ, Pakistani breakfast, naan, chicken curries, daal, rice dishes, Anda Shami Burger and our signature Pakistani Pitta Shawarma. Located in Al Karama near BurJuman, Cheezy Bites is ideal for breakfast, lunch, dinner, dine-in, takeaway and delivery. We focus on freshly prepared food, generous portions and authentic Pakistani flavours for families and food lovers across Karama and Bur Dubai!!!

reviews.author: Farooq Chattha
reviews.text:
Had a great experience at Cheezy Bites in Karama! The food was fresh, cheesy (as the name promises 😄), and full of flavor. The portions were generous and totally worth the price. Service was quick and friendly, and the staff made us feel welcome.

Perfect spot if you’re craving comfort food like loaded fries, burgers, or anything cheesy. Will definitely be coming back!”

reviews.author: Wakezone LLC
reviews.text: I had a great experience at Cheezy Bites! The food was fresh, tasty, and served quickly. The staff were friendly and welcoming, and the place was clean and comfortable. Definitely a good spot if you're craving cheesy snacks and quick bites. I’ll be coming back again!
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you for such a great review. We will look forward to host you again.

reviews.author: Abdul Rehman Ghayas
reviews.text: Great food, especially the Cheese Sticks, Pizza, Shami Kabab Burger, and Shawarma Platter absolutely loved them! The service was also very nice and welcoming.

reviews.author: Husnain Rizvi
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed the food, it's delicious, tasty and fresh.

reviews.author: mak tradelink
reviews.text:
I recently had one of the best meals I’ve ever experienced. Everything was spot on from the presentation to the taste. The food was fresh, full of flavor, and clearly made with care. Every bite felt balanced and satisfying, and you could tell quality ingredients were used.

What really stood out was how consistent everything was. The main dish was excellent, and even the sides were just as impressive. The service added to the experience, making it even more enjoyable.

Honestly, this is the kind of place you remember and want to come back to. Highly recommended for anyone who truly enjoys good food.
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re truly delighted to hear that every aspect of your experience from the food and presentation to the service met your expectations. Our team puts great care into ensuring consistency and quality

We can’t wait to welcome you back for another memorable meal :-)

reviews.text:

Great food, great service, and a welcoming atmosphere. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.text: Lovely atmosphere and delicious food! There is a large choice on the menu so it's perfect for families and friends, we tried pizza, shawarma, lasagne and garlic bread and all the food was well flavoured and tasty. Very impressed and would highly recommend 😊

reviews.author: Emmie Gresola
reviews.text: Today was my first visit, and I can't help but share how incredible the experience was! 🎉 I’m already looking forward to becoming a regular at this fantastic restaurant. The ambiance is inviting, and the staff are truly wonderful—especially Sakita, who made our visit even more special. 🥰 We indulged in their Chicken Shawarma, Lahori Chargha, and an Avocado Shake, and let me tell you, each dish was a delight! If you haven't tried it yet, you're missing out! 😉

reviews.author: Areesha
reviews.text: Friendly and welcoming staff, good ambiance. Love the bun kabab and chicken shawarma fries. Excellent service. Shagun was so sweet and helpful. Can’t wait to visit again!

reviews.text: Cheezy bites Restaurant near BurJuman Exit is one of the best places for loaded Pakistani and Indian dishes. The food is rich in flavor, generously portioned, and truly satisfying. The staff are extremely friendly, polite, and welcoming, which makes the dining experience even better. Highly recommended for anyone craving authentic desi food.

reviews.text: Great Service. Their Bun Kabab is authentic and spicy. The Tandoori Chicken Hot Pizza was excellent and the Shawarma was made spicy as it should be. All in all, I feel like I've had one of the best street foods.

reviews.author: kaamini singh
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience at Cheesy Bite restaurant. The food was absolutely delicious and every dish was so flavorful. The ambiance was great and the place was clean and welcoming. The best part was the staff—they were all very polite and attentive. Especially Januka, who provided exceptional service—she took care of us so well. I highly recommend Cheesy Bite for amazing food and top-notch service! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: Sheetal Gaikwad
reviews.text: It was a wonderful experience. I ordered garlic bread. Chicken cheese naan n chicken shawarma cheesy fires. The food was absolutely delicious. However the chicken shawarma cheesy fries just had 3 small pieces of chicken. Little expensive. Food quality is good and the staff is very kind.
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you for your feedback. We’ll definitely take note of the portion size for the Chicken Shawarma Cheesy Fries and see how we can improve it to ensure better value for our customers.
Your input is invaluable in helping us refine our offerings. We appreciate your visit and hope to serve you again soon!

reviews.author: Von Du30
reviews.text:
I think this is a newly opened restaurant in the neighborhood. Was craving for burgers so we decided to come here and try.

We had some pasta, shawarma, burgers and loaded fries. My most favorite is the loaded fries! The best! Superb! The pasta was good too.. although they needed to calm down on the peppercorns on the pasta. I believe I tasted way too much pepper on the pasta- but the food was still super good regardless! 👌🏻

We weren't able to try the burger and shawarma yet because we were already full from the loaded fries and pasta so we had it for take away and eat tomorrow at work! 😄

The staff were amazing although I feel like they are in a rush or something. But understandable cause they're a bit busy during my visit. Very friendly and accommodating on the other hand. Thanks!

Place was amazing. Clean and tidy! Super love the ambiance as it feels cozy and elegant. Love the wooden chairs and table and the walls! Although I feel the area is a bit too tight? Nonetheless very nice ambiance as it was super clean!

I recommend visiting and will definitely come again soon!

Thank you!!

reviews.author: Saqib Abbas
reviews.text: I dined in cheezy bites, great atmosphere, delicious food, and the service is v good. U have to wait a bit longer due to plenty of orders but it's worth due to food taste. I tried chargha which is superb. Mr. Sajid gave the best service there.

reviews.author: Rajiv Das
reviews.text:
One of the best spots for fusion food all in one place! If you’re craving different flavors together—shawarma, pizza, tawa chicken and many more dishes—this restaurant is a perfect choice.

The food is fresh, tasty, and full of flavor. What I like most is that you don’t have to visit multiple places; everything is available here, making it great for families and friends with different cravings. The shawarma is juicy, the pizza is well-baked, and the tawa chicken is rich in spices.

Service is quick, prices are reasonable, and the overall vibe is very welcoming. Definitely a place I would recommend if you want variety and good taste at the same time.

reviews.text: One of the best restaurants in Karama. This was a hidden gem, how did I missed it! I loved their chicken pasta, chissy bites special pizza, and tawa chicken. Service is good and prompt. Sure will visit again.

reviews.text: The food was absolutely delicious and full of flavor. Every dish was fresh, well presented, and clearly made with care. The service was also excellent — warm, attentive, and professional throughout the experience.

reviews.author: Abdullah Jatt
reviews.text: I tried the Pakistani shawarma at Cheesy Bites in Al Karama and it was amazing! The shawarma was very flavorful with the perfect mix of spicy sauces and juicy chicken. reviews.author: i_am_ pia
reviews.text:
We recently visited Cheezy Bites and tried their Chapli Kabab, Shawarma, and Mango Smoothie. Here’s how it went:

Chapli Kabab: The Chapli Kabab was full of flavor with a perfect blend of spices. The texture was just right—crispy on the outside, tender on the inside. It had an authentic taste.

Shawarma: The Shawarma was juicy and packed with ingredients. The meat was flavorful, and the sauces added a nice tang.

Mango Smoothie: The Mango Smoothie was refreshing, thick, and just the right level of sweetness. It paired well with the spicy dishes and was a perfect way to finish off the meal.

Overall, Cheezy Bites offers great comfort food at reasonable prices, with the Chapli Kabab being the highlight for me. Definitely worth trying if you’re in the mood for flavorful bites!
